Grape & vinery inspired shader
VIZA 616 · Environment Mapping Study
Normal-map reflection study

Environmental Reflections
vineyard inspired

An exploration of environment-based reflection using a grape normal map and a winery-barrel environment. Click and drag across the preview to change the light position and observe how the surface response shifts. The image is a 2D normal-map approximation rather than a fully modeled 3D scene.

Interactive study

Click and drag over the image to move the light
Add channel images to activate the preview.

How to interact

Click and drag over the preview. The light direction changes with the mouse position, affecting the diffuse shading on the grape surface.

The normal map determines the reflected direction used to sample the winery environment map. The Ks map controls how much of that reflection is mixed into the grape surface.

Shader inputs

Image slot
Grape normal map
iChannel0

Normal map

Stores surface-normal directions as RGB values. The shader decodes these values into vectors that control the reflected direction across each grape.

Image slot
Winery HDRI / environment map
iChannel1

Environment map

Provides the winery image sampled in the reflected direction. Its colors and visible features appear on the reflective grape surfaces.

Image slot
Ks reflection map
iChannel2

Ks map

Controls reflection strength per pixel. Brighter values produce a stronger environment reflection where darker values preserve more of the grape's diffuse color.

Image slot
Background photograph
iChannel3

Background photo

Appears behind the grape cluster. A color-key mask is created by comparing the normal-map background color against the grape pixels.

Project description

Method and shader concepts

Environment-based reflection

This study decodes the normal map from RGB into a normalized vector. A view direction and the surface normal are then used to calculate a reflected direction. That direction is converted into environment-map coordinates and used to sample the winery HDRI.

The sampled environment color is blended with a diffuse grape color. A Ks texture controls the reflection contribution, allowing reflection strength to vary across the surface. A color comparison against the normal map's flat background creates a silhouette mask, so the grape result can be composited over the background img.

Example code takeaway

The shader builds on the environment-map and reflection examples provided from professor Akleman's course material. It retains the core operations of decoding a normal map, normalizing the view and surface directions, calculating the reflected vector with the dot product, converting that vector to environment UV coordinates, sampling the environment texture, and using Ks to control the reflection blend.
